# Derive searching UI state from the actual view state

480 introduced an immediate searching class separate from an older debounce. Current reflectFiltererResults toggles searching from gViewWrapper.searching and returns when gDBView is absent; the old filterActive delay is gone. Keep UI state tied to the view lifecycle and avoid copying historical timers as current behavior.

Scope: mail/base/content.

## Evidence

[Lesson record](../records/e464c0ffe1fafb734a14be09e1cea9746053afc127b2d19be26f70106c4b19d1.json).
